VERIFICATION NOTES / NOVEMBER 2, 2026

Evidence, with its boundaries.

This is a sanitized summary of the retained November 2 release-repair execution: 147 tests passed, including all 133 R1 cases and the original 86. The current final website audit performs new static and browser checks; it does not rerun the MediFlow tests. Original artifacts remain local and are not embedded here.

What the tests establish

For the tested synthetic histories: complete analytical group sets and measures match independent expectations; replay is idempotent; late corrections are applied; and recovery works at the tested process-crash checkpoints. These results do not establish hardware power-loss durability, clinical safety, production readiness, or historical employment metrics.

Performance context

The final recorded demonstration took 93.504068 seconds internally and 107.247500 seconds including process startup. It ran alongside the regression suite. It is one local synthetic workload measurement, not a controlled comparison or throughput guarantee. Peak RAM was not measured.

Artifact hashes identify the retained source evidence. They do not provide external certification. Machine paths, hostname, raw records, and personal contact details were excluded from this summary.

Reproduction boundary

The existing approved Windows environment uses Python 3.13, DuckDB and PyArrow. A configurable runtime and independent copied-source execution were verified using the existing dependencies. Clean-room installation remains unverified; deep Windows filesystem paths remain limited. No live patient data, cloud service, or model is used by this website.
